extraction: Read GLB JSON/BIN only; decoded source POSITION and indices, applied node scale/translation and scene frame/box relative transforms. Source files were not executed or modified.
geometry: 35 planar selectable meshes, not volumetric cubes. Each mesh retains its original node name and source triangles.
differences: Camera/marker tracking replaced by drag rotation and an offline light background.
Canvas uses orthographic projection; source glTF PBR/emissive rendering is approximated.
Number labels, keyboard grid, reset view and progressively revealed assistance are restoration additions.
Correct answer callback after 1 second; host supplies the remaining original transition.
Original paper marker contains an empty white puzzle region; the filled paper result is not available in this component. Hints explicitly disclose the source-derived answer.
